hypotheses: Selumetinib inhibits MEK1/2, reducing ERK signaling and downstream histone-modifying enzyme activity, leading to decreased H3K27me3K36me0 (BI10043) and H3K27me2K36me1 (BI10040) and increased H3K9me1K14ac0 (BI10009) and H3K9ac1K14ac0 (BI10012).

Selumetinib may indirectly inhibit CDK9 or other kinases, altering RNA polymerase II phosphorylation and histone acetylation, producing a pattern similar to CDK inhibitors like dinaciclib or flavopiridol.
Selumetinib may inhibit JAK2 or other kinases, affecting histone methylation and acetylation, similar to TG101348.
Selumetinib may inhibit BRAF or other MAPK pathway components, altering histone modifications, similar to vemurafenib.
Selumetinib may inhibit AKT or other kinases, affecting histone modifications, similar to afuresertib.
object.evidence_gap: No direct evidence links selumetinib to specific histone modification changes in A375 cells at 5.5 uM for 24 hours. The donor descriptions are needed to assess whether their pharmacological mechanisms overlap with selumetinib and could explain the observed histone mark pattern.
